description: Details of one of your own certificates by its code: equipment, serial, dates, live state and days left, the recorded reading table, the public verification link, and earlier certificates for the same serial. Someone else's code returns not found. Values under as_recorded_on_certificate are exactly what was entered on the certificate; Barmaan makes no accreditation claim. The printable sheet is on the website (signed in): /portal/certificates/<code>/print.
name: certificate_get
title: One of my calibration certificates
